_comment: Rhubarb Lip Sync mouth shapes (A-H, X) -> CJ mouth-kit indices. Shape definitions verbatim from Rhubarb 1.14.0 README.adoc (vendored in tools/rhubarb/). Hanna-Barbera 6-shape base + 3 optional extended shapes.

A.note: Closed mouth for P/B/M (slight lip pressure) -> M_B_P

B.note: Slightly open, clenched teeth; most consonants K/S/T, EE vowel -> teeth_clench

C.note: Open; EH (men), AE (bat); in-between A/B->D -> E_I

E.note: Slightly rounded; AO (off), ER (bird); in-between C/D->F -> O_OO

G.note: OPTIONAL extended: upper teeth on lower lip, F/V -> F viseme

H.note: OPTIONAL extended: long L, tongue raised -> L_Th

X.note: OPTIONAL extended: idle/pauses, relaxed closed -> resting
